About

Glam & Go Salon JVC is your go-to beauty salon in JVC, Dubai, where looking good meets feeling good. We offer polished, confidence-boosting results in a warm neighborhood salon atmosphere. Our most-loved services include hair colour, balayage, blow dries, hair extensions, BIAB & hard gel nails, manicures, pedicures, semi-permanent makeup, lash treatments, facials, waxing, and threading. Clients love our natural results, skilled team, premium products, and home service across Dubai. Xx
